opportunities.title: No published LLM benchmark results
opportunities.detail: Neither of the two multilingual benchmarks we track reports this language. Adding it would give builders and buyers a baseline.
opportunities.why: About 4.1 million Guarani speakers are online and able to text today, and that should reach 4.6 million within five years. Ready to use: FLORES-200 (covers this language); Belebele (covers this language).

opportunities.title: No published speech recognition error rate
opportunities.detail: The language isn't in the published FLEURS error-rate breakdowns we track, so builders can't tell how usable open speech recognition is.
opportunities.why: About 4.8 million Guarani speakers are online today, and that should reach 5.4 million within five years. Ready to use: YODAS2 (1.1 hours of transcribed speech); Mozilla Common Voice (5.2 hours of transcribed speech).

opportunities.title: No major speech input service, though open resources exist
opportunities.detail: Open datasets hold 6.2 hours of transcribed speech, and an open model lists the language.
opportunities.why: About 4.8 million Guarani speakers are online today, and that should reach 5.4 million within five years. Ready to use: YODAS2 (1.1 hours of transcribed speech); Mozilla Common Voice (5.2 hours of transcribed speech).

opportunities.title: No cloud text-to-speech voice found, though open resources exist
opportunities.detail: None of the cloud services checked has a voice for this language. An open text-to-speech model already speaks it. Open datasets hold 6.2 hours of transcribed speech.
opportunities.why: About 4.8 million Guarani speakers are online today, and that should reach 5.4 million within five years. Ready to use: MMS text-to-speech (covers this language); YODAS2 (1.1 hours of transcribed speech).

opportunities.title: An open spell-checker exists that more word processors could adopt
opportunities.detail: An open dictionary or grammar checker covers this language, but the most widely used word processors don't check it yet.
opportunities.why: About 4.1 million Guarani speakers are online and able to text today, and that should reach 4.6 million within five years. Ready to use: LibreOffice dictionaries (covers this language).

opportunities.title: Volunteers translate an open browser, but no major platform
opportunities.detail: A volunteer community already maintains a full browser translation, with terminology a platform could build on.
opportunities.why: About 4.1 million Guarani speakers are online and able to text today, and that should reach 4.6 million within five years. Ready to use: Firefox localisation (Pontoon) (covers this language).

opportunities.title: Locale data in Unicode CLDR is missing
opportunities.detail: Complete CLDR data (names, dates, numbers, character sets) underpins interface localisation, keyboards and reading numbers aloud in text-to-speech.
opportunities.why: About 4.1 million Guarani speakers are online and able to text today, and that should reach 4.6 million within five years.

opportunities.title: No text recognition, open or commercial
opportunities.detail: Printed books, signs and forms can't be read by phone cameras or digitised at scale.
opportunities.why: About 4.1 million Guarani speakers are online and able to text today, and that should reach 4.6 million within five years.

opportunities.title: Only 6.2 hours of open transcribed speech
opportunities.detail: Counted across the open speech datasets we track. Image-prompted field collection has worked at scale for Indian and African languages.
opportunities.why: About 4.8 million Guarani speakers are online today, and that should reach 5.4 million within five years.

opportunities.title: Wikipedia has 28 active editors
opportunities.detail: A small editing community limits new open text. Edit-a-thons and translation drives with universities have grown communities elsewhere.
opportunities.why: About 4.1 million Guarani speakers are online and able to text today, and that should reach 4.6 million within five years.

opportunities.title: Translation is offered by 2 of 3 major services
opportunities.detail: An open model and the FLORES-200 evaluation set already cover this language, so the main remaining step is a product launch.
opportunities.why: About 4.1 million Guarani speakers are online and able to text today, and that should reach 4.6 million within five years. Ready to use: NLLB-200 (covers this language); FLORES-200 (covers this language).

opportunities.title: Only about 7 million words of open web text
opportunities.detail: Little text online limits language models and word prediction. Digitising books and news archives is often the fastest route.
opportunities.why: About 4.1 million Guarani speakers are online and able to text today, and that should reach 4.6 million within five years.
